Hm, not sure if I completely understand why you merge release branches with master and delete them and so on...
Wouldn't it be easier to use the normal development model?
It could well be
That is, master is for development, and for each release you have a branch like stable-0.2.x
If you have any fixes to backport, you just cherry-pick it from master into the stable branch
And tags again for the individual releases
I mostly agree - except I want stable to be the default, and development branches to be non-default
I've had far too much time with non-building master to be happy with having that as the default every clone gets is all
Essentially... protecting myself and the tree from the developers :P
Not sure about that
If I want to have a stable version, I get a tarball
Fair enough

And most broken, of course ;-)

git clone has a -b parameter, so if you provide the whole command line, it might do the trick
